title: Settle in and stay connected
steps: Save your university's emergency contact details.
Keep digital and paper copies of your travel documents.
Arrange a local SIM or eSIM for arrival.

title: Register and protect your identity
steps: Check your visa conditions and note any reporting deadlines.
Ask your university about student registration and campus ID.

title: Set up everyday essentials
steps: Ask your bank about account requirements for students.
Set up a secure way to receive one-time passcodes.
Learn how to report a lost bank card.

title: Know how to get care
steps: Find your campus clinic and nearby public hospital.
Check your insurance and emergency care coverage.

title: Plan cross-border essentials
steps: Check travel and entry requirements before each trip.
Confirm your phone can receive important messages while abroad.
Keep contact details for your consulate and university support team.
